title: Post the school's daily close in Slack
summary: Every evening, post the day's fees collected, what is unmatched and whether the day reconciles in a Slack channel.
description: Every evening at the time you choose, takes the school's daily close (fees collected, money matched and unmatched, cash pending, and the checks that do not reconcile) and posts it in the Slack channel you choose, flagged when the day does not reconcile.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the close is posted, Lagos time.

params.name: app_link
params.title: Link
params.description: Where the close links to: your Taskiem address, so the bursar can open the day.

params.name: slack_connection
params.title: Slack connection
params.description: Your Slack workspace, connected with Add to Slack.

params.name: channel
params.title: Slack channel
params.description: Where the message is posted. For a private channel, invite the Taskiem app to it first.

definition.name: Post the school's daily close in Slack

input.text: ='Daily close ' + steps.close.output.day + (steps.close.output.reconciles ? '' : ': DOES NOT RECONCILE') + '\n' + steps.close.output.text
